description.narrative: Energy sector Review. Joint exercise by donors and Ministry of Energy. Sweden finances the consultancy support.
Sektorsgenomgång av energisektorn. Genomförs av biståndsgivare och energiministeriet. Sverige finansierar konsultstödet.

The Objectives with the intervention is to undertake an energy sector review in Tanzania. The review is done jointly by the Tanzanian government and development cooperation partners in Tanzania active in the energy sector. The review had the help from a procured consultancy that did interviews, data compilation and report writing.

sector.narrative: Energy sector policy, planning and administration

description.narrative: The review, which was more or less completed in mid-2020, was the first joint government-development partner energy sector review undertaken since 2014. During the past 4-5 years, the government-development partner cooperation have been limited, apart from specific project support, and dialogue around energy sector development has been non-existant. The result has therefore been twofold; i) the actual energy sector review has provided substantial and useful input to the Tanzanian government for them to use in e.g. decisionmaking relating to the energy sector. It has also ii) improved the government - development partner relations, providing a platform for energy sector dialogue.
